_readme: Default local Mock Mail/Calendar Gateway. No external account or OAuth required. Real applications are configured separately.
_usage: node bin/trace-manager.js            # 启动全部上游，常驻，Ctrl+C 收尾并打印统计
node bin/trace-manager.js --once     # 启动→等就绪→打印报告→退出（全就绪 exit 0，否则 exit 3）
node bin/trace-manager.js --status   # 查正在跑的实例（人读；npm run status 等价）
换实验：只改 experimentRunId；换端口：只改 http.port 或用 --port
